assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The services were provided without prior authorization.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The claim is for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
